tagline: A purpose-built company to help accelerate the energy transition.
hero_kpi_rationale: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) is a key indicator of future demand for GE Vernova's equipment and services, reflecting the energy transition and modernization of electrical infrastructure.

kpis.name: Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO)
kpis.explanation: Total firm and unconditional customer orders for equipment and services not yet delivered.
kpis.description: RPO increased 26% to reach $150.2 billion, primarily driven by the Power and Electrification segments.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in order backlog, signaling robust future demand.

kpis.name: Total revenues
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of goods and services generated by the company.
kpis.description: Total revenues increased 9% to reach $38.1 billion, driven by performance in the Electrification and Power segments.
kpis.signal: Solid revenue growth, driven by equipment and services.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after deduction of all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income surged 213% to reach $4.9 billion, marking a strong recovery in profitability.

kpis.name: Net income margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue that translates into net profit.
kpis.description: Net income margin reached 12.8%, a significant increase from the prior year, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in net income margin.

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core business activities before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating income increased 195% to reach $1.4 billion, indicating improved operational performance.

kpis.name: Operating cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by the company's routine operating activities.
kpis.description: Operating cash flow reached $5.0 billion, up 92%, demonstrating strong cash generation capability.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash remaining after deduction of capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Free cash flow more than doubled to reach $3.7 billion, indicating increased capacity to invest or return capital to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in free cash flow.

kpis.name: Tariff costs
kpis.explanation: Additional costs incurred from tariffs imposed by governments, net of mitigation measures.
kpis.description: Tariffs resulted in net costs of approximately $250 million in 2025, after accounting for contractual protections and mitigation measures.
kpis.signal: Financial impact of tariffs in 2025, partially offset by mitigation measures.

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends for the last three fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.0 in the last year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow for the last three fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.275 billion in the last year.

kpis.name: Acquisition of remaining stake in Prolec GE
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of the remaining 50% stake in Prolec GE, a leading supplier of grid equipment manufacturing transformers.
kpis.description: GE Vernova announced the acquisition of the remaining 50% stake in Prolec GE for $5.3 billion, to be financed equally in cash and debt, with closing expected in February 2026.
kpis.signal: Major strategic move to strengthen position in the grid equipment and transformation market.

kpis.name: Creation of Power Conversion Storage business unit
kpis.explanation: Combination of the Power Conversion and Solar Storage Solutions business units within the Electrification segment to form a new integrated unit.
kpis.description: Effective January 1, 2025, Power Conversion and Solar Storage Solutions activities were consolidated to form the Power Conversion Storage unit within the Electrification segment.
kpis.signal: Structural reorganization to better serve growing demand in energy storage and conversion.
